author: caleb_gl
body:
Just wanted to say a couple of things here. This isn't a rant about lag, just to make myself clear. 

When they first come onto the server, I'd assume most new players don't know whats going on. They might learn over time, but I've seen a lot of newer players ask "Where are the monuments?" or "What do I have to do?" The second one is a harmful one, because if no one cares to answer, then they might not stay on the server. If Avicus can't explain how it's game modes work, then newer players will feel awkward and unsure of what to do. 

What can Avicus do to fix this? 

First of all, FIX THE GAME BOOKLET! During the spectator mode of the beginning of the game, the inventory (besides the map) is the first thing the players go over. The game booklet doesn't work. If the booklets worked, the game modes could actually be explained, and if they were map specific, they would be a godsend for any player. Right now, the only way to find monuments is to fly around and search - and if they're hidden, like Castle in The Rocks, then it's significantly more difficult to understand. Fix the booklet!
Edit: I really think the booklet is a forgotten mechanic and I think it can be expanded on. Hopefully this idea will make it through. 

Second of all, if not the booklet, have a tutorial for newer players! There are areas of the spawn area which are unused. If new players are auto-tp'd to a tutorial, or they see a tutorial sign, then they can go through it to fully understand. The spawn is useless as a mechanic for anything else, it's only used to occasionally talk. No one uses the signs which let you join servers - I myself didn't even notice them for a couple of months, and I still don't use them. 

---

Okay. That's all for that. (If you don't want to read about more general fixes and balances, don't read on)
A couple of other (more general) things:  

1. There NEEDS to be a global announcement for cases (with a link to the shop). Apparently, if they aren't explained, people don't understand them (and no one has played CSGO, I guess). 

2. And speaking of cases, there should be a credit reward in addition to the prize. The awards are not practical at all in terms of the game, AND speaking of which ... 

3. Credits are USELESS ingame (and they shouldn't be). They serve no purpose, besides for buying badges and other cosmetic items. The shop (Spanky Spade anyone?) should be brought back for this purpose, albeit nerfed.
3a. Thanks to zero9178: Purchases in the shop should be a one-time buy with credits and then from there on should be bought with killpoints. 

4. Trails sometime show up in spectator mode. Not a bad thing, not a good thing, just noticing. 

5. In the menu to join servers they move around. I've never understood this mechanic as it can sometimes lead people to join the wrong server. No one would notice if they stayed still. This is more of a nuisance, but y'know. 

EXTRA EDITS: 

6. Credits should be used to buy cases. It should take a lot of credits, if you want to balance it with paying for it. This is how Pay2Win games work - make the goal really hard, or just pay for it (except this isn't Pay2Win). This might negate #2 of my agenda, but I'm willing to compromise. Also, (thanks Porky), sell cases for credits. The balancing of the system is weird, but if the cases are to be done right they shouldn't be unbalanced (assuming that the cases are good monetarily for the server, in which case they need to be balanced). 

---

Thanks for reading, and I hope some of this is considered!
/summon kylo            

Update Jan 11th: Editing #6 for clarity, thanks Porky, also updated #3 with a #3a, thanks Zero.
